Subject: Re: [Python-3000] python-safethread project status

Dnia 18-03-2008, Wt o godzinie 11:24 -0600, Adam Olsen pisze: > If they need access to containing objects the only option is to use > the underlying tool, deathqueues. Deathqueues are a part of python-safethread, right? Interesting, but just like the finalization design, the design with weakrefs being added to deathqueues instead of using weakref callbacks is exactly what I consider the right design of weakrefs (or actually it's a superset of my design which does not include a blocking wait). I see that you are implementing thread interrupts, which might be the third thing that you are doing my way, and I am beginning to worry about these coincidences.
